item.title: Cursor's Bill Disappeared. The Official Answer: Deliberate Design.
item.description: On July 31st, Cursor quietly removed dollar amounts from its usage page, zeroed out API cost fields, and an official employee confirmed it was 'deliberate design.' Meanwhile, real benchmark data shows token consumption varies 30x across agent harnesses. This isn't a UI change — it's a business signal.
